claim: For the three-qubit Heisenberg \(XXX\) ring with one exchange impurity studied by Hu and Tian, let \(J_1>0\) be the two impurity-bond couplings, let \(J\) be the remaining bond coupling, and restrict to the zero-temperature-entangled regime \(r=J/J_1<1\). The impurity-neighbor concurrence has a unique positive critical temperature \(T_c\), and after setting \(u=J_1/T_c\) its threshold is the universal equation \[e^{6u}=e^{(2+4r)u}+4.\] Hence \(T_c/J_1=t(r)=1/u(r)\) is a single universal curve, with \(u(r)\) strictly increasing and \(t(r)\) strictly decreasing for all \(r<1\). As the antiferromagnetic activation boundary is approached, \(r\uparrow1\), \[\frac{T_c}{J_1}\sim\frac{6}{W\!\left(6/(1-r)\right)},\] where \(W\) is the principal Lambert function; equivalently, for fixed \(J>0\), \(T_c\sim 6J_1/W\!\left(6J_1/(J_1-J)\right)\) as \(J_1\downarrow J\). At the opposite strong-impurity endpoint, if \(z_0>1\) is the unique real root of \(z^3-z-4=0\), then \[T_c=\alpha J_1-\beta J+O(J^2/J_1),\qquad \alpha=\frac{2}{\log z_0}=3.414477321211954\ldots,\qquad \beta=\alpha\frac{z_0}{z_0+6}=0.786717182330735\ldots.\] The source reported only the numerical leading slope \(3.41448\) for \(J_1\gg |J|\); the universal scaling curve, its first finite-\(J\) correction, and the inverse-logarithmic collapse at \(J_1\downarrow J\) sharpen the impurity thermal-entanglement phase boundary.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; deterministic direct-matrix replay is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: The universal dimensionless threshold curve, uniqueness and monotonicity of its root, the Lambert-function activation asymptotic, and the first finite-\(J\) strong-impurity correction.
integrity.ownership_basis: The mathematical bibliographic record lists Quantum measurement theory, state operations, state preparations (81P15) first, followed by 81P68 and 82B20.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The source concurrence formula, zero-temperature activation region, monotonic growth of \(T_c\) with impurity strength, and leading numerical slope \(3.41448\) are explicitly credited.
integrity.source_date_basis: The mathematical bibliographic record gives the exact publication date 2007-07-30; the inspected journal full text labels the issue April 2007 without an exact day, and received/accepted dates were not substituted for publication.

scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns impurity-neighbor concurrence in the periodic three-spin isotropic Heisenberg \(XXX\) model with \(J_1>0\) and \(J/J_1<1\).
The Lambert-function law is an endpoint asymptotic for \(J>0\) and \(J_1\downarrow J\), not a global approximation.
The strong-impurity correction holds for fixed \(J\) as \(J_1\to\infty\).
The closely related 2002 \(XX\)-chain paper was available only at abstract level in the inspected sources.
title: Universal impurity-temperature curve and endpoint laws in a three-spin XXX ring
